title: edge
$comment: A graph edge in JOIN-TABLE form (the alternative to adjacency-in-record edges[]). NOT one of the 6 completeness-law record types -- it is the traversable-graph structure (R2: 'what connects to X' answered by a query, not a scan). The LINKER emits these on write. Edge STORAGE (this join-table shape vs inline edges[] in each record) is the P0/P1 open item; both shapes are fixed here so either store satisfies the same contract.
